description: This file defines the Charmap class, a bit-vector map for 8-bit unsigned characters, including methods for initialization, set operations, and character range creation. It is part of the Abseil string internal utilities.

classes.name: Charmap
classes.description: A class representing a bit-vector map for 8-bit characters, supporting set operations, range creation, and character containment checks.

methods.name: Charmap()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty character map.

methods.name: Charmap(const char* str, int len)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the map with characters from a string, with specified length.

methods.name: Charmap(const char* str)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the map with characters from a null-terminated string.

methods.name: contains(unsigned char c) const
methods.description: Checks if a character is in the map.

methods.name: IntersectsWith(const Charmap& c) const
methods.description: Checks if there is any common character between two maps.

methods.name: IsZero() const
methods.description: Checks if the map contains no characters.

methods.name: Char(char x)
methods.description: Creates a map containing only the specified character.

methods.name: FromString(const char* s)
methods.description: Creates a map containing all characters in the given string.

methods.name: Range(char lo, char hi)
methods.description: Creates a map containing all characters in the inclusive range [lo, hi].
